_about: Slugs whose Did-you-know card a human confirmed is about the right artist. Shown even if the automatic gate (facts_gate.py) would hold it back. Optional "src" pins the exact source URL: if the stored fact is re-fetched from a different page, it is hidden again. artist_facts_deny.json still wins.

airbag.note: Airbag = the Estepona pop-punk trio (formed 1998, 9th studio album "Una Extraña Fuerza"), confirmed on La Cochera Cabaret's own event page 2026-10-21 (lacocheracabaret.com/evento/airbag-2/); MusicBrainz id matches (Spanish pop punk band, begin-area Estepona, 1998-08). NOT the Norwegian or Argentine Airbag.

sasha.note: Sasha (DJ), Alexander Paul Coe, British DJ - confirmed by the True Club x Vicious Lab ticket page (ingresse.com: "el DJ británico") 2026-10-21. NOT Sasha Grey, NOT the German pop singer.
